description: Improved configuration based on 512-step success analysis - Full data, Full features, Longer training with early stopping
comment_experiment: v376: Fix short-step overfitting by expanding data/features and using random_start
comment_strategy: 5000+ data rows, 110 features (full), random_start=true, 20k-50k timesteps, frequent eval
comment_target: HOLD <40%, Reward >0, Maintain 512-step success over long training
comment_analysis_findings: Problem: 512 steps succeed (reward 383, HOLD 40%), but 2560+ steps degrade (reward -135, HOLD 63%)
Root cause 1: Data exhaustion - 500 rows repeated → policy overfits to HOLD safety
Root cause 2: Feature limitation - max_features=60 reduces information diversity
Root cause 3: No random start → same sequence reinforces bias
Root cause 4: Entropy decay unchecked → exploration dies after 512 steps
Solution: Expand data to 5000+, use all 110 features, enable random_start, maintain entropy
changes: max_features: 60 → null (use all ~110 features with correlation filtering)
target_kl: NEW 0.03 (early stop on policy divergence)
eval_freq: 2000 → 1000 (more frequent evaluation for manual monitoring)

expected_behavior.trade_pattern: Active trading maintained over long training
expected_behavior.convergence: Gradual, with early stopping to prevent HOLD bias

validation_plan.step_1: Run for 5000 steps - expect similar to baseline (reward ~300, HOLD ~40%)
validation_plan.step_2: Continue to 10000 steps - check if HOLD stays <50% with random_start
validation_plan.step_3: Continue to 20000 steps - verify entropy maintained and reward stable
validation_plan.step_4: Full 30000 steps - confirm no degradation, or early stop if plateau detected
